title: NUTRIBENCH: A DATASET FOR EVALUATING LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS ON NUTRITION ESTIMATION FROM MEAL DESCRIPTIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of LLM carbohydrate predictions across meal descriptions originating from 11 different countries to identify performance disparities across different cultural cuisines.

Correlating the carbohydrate content of single-item meals with the prediction error (MAE) to evaluate whether models systematically perform better for individuals following low-carbohydrate diets compared to high-carbohydrate diets.
